scope: Bounded analyzer sandbox isolation, private 0700 scratch directory allocation with quota tracking and traversal guard, outbound network dial guard, strict deadline enforcement, and read-only sealed evidence post-analysis byte verification

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.

Passed all 11 tests in cmd/breachatlas and all test suites in tests (C05 through C15, including 8 C15 sandbox isolation, read-only evidence immutability, tamper-on-error precedence, scratch truncation recovery and quota/traversal, network guard, deadline enforcement, orphan recovery, prerequisite validation, and concurrent race tests).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked 220 JSON files and repository contract invariants.

observations: NewSandbox and RunIsolated in internal/analyzers/sandbox.go enforce read-only evidence access via strict O_RDONLY open checks, failing closed with ErrEvidenceWriteForbidden on any write or non-read-only flag.

Pre- and post-analysis byte invariant verification asserts sealed evidence file size and SHA-256 digest are identical before and after execution; if sealed evidence is modified or deleted during execution, ErrEvidenceModified takes precedence over worker errors or deadline cancellations.

Private dedicated scratch directories are allocated with strict 0700 filesystem permissions, path traversal escapes (.. and absolute paths) are rejected fail-closed with ErrSandboxEscaped, symlinks pointing outside scratch are blocked, and disk usage is capped by MaxScratchBytes returning ErrScratchLimitExceeded.
ScratchController reclaims disk quota on file truncation and file removal, prevents raw OpenFile write bypasses, and guards against post-cleanup orphaned writes with cleaned state tracking.
NetworkGuard blocks outbound network connections fail-closed returning ErrNetworkForbidden on all Dial, DialContext, and HTTP requests.
Configured execution timeouts are strictly enforced; slow or hanging analyzers are aborted on context deadline expiry with ErrDeadlineExceeded and scratch directories are safely freed.

CleanOrphans safely sweeps abandoned scratch directories from interrupted runs without corrupting sealed evidence or interfering with active executions, fully synchronized against concurrent allocations.
Prerequisites (case_id, evidence_id, allowlisted analyzer_id, provider) are validated before scratch allocation.
Concurrent executions under go test -race on shared sealed evidence pass cleanly without data races or byte modification.

observed_limitations: Persistent derived artifact manifests, retention schedules, and downstream timeline aggregations (C16) are deferred to their planned task.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert internal/analyzers/sandbox.go, tests/isolation_test.go, tests/fixtures/breachatlas/C15, and docs/evidence/C15.json. No database schemas, migrations, .env files, or Dockerfiles were modified.
